import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Dataset for interaction feature creation
data = {
    'height': [160, 170, 175, 180, 165, 190],
    'weight': [55, 70, 75, 85, 60, 95],
    'age': [25, 30, 35, 40, 28, 45],
    'exercise_hours': [5, 3, 2, 1, 4, 0]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create BMI as an interaction feature
df['BMI'] = df['weight'] / (df['height'] / 100) ** 2

# Create age-exercise interaction
df['age_exercise'] = df['age'] * df['exercise_hours']

# Create a ratio feature
df['exercise_per_year'] = df['exercise_hours'] / df['age']

# Print the dataframe with all new interaction features
print("DataFrame with Interaction Features:")
print(df)
